title: Unforgetful is a new reminders app for people who can't stop hitting snooze | TechCrunch
summary: Because the app works with your existing Apple Reminders, you can continue using reminders as you always have — you just turn off the Apple Reminders notifications and replace them with Unforgetful notifications instead.
